_sources.params: Policy v7 constants from the v7 rehearsal on the local solver.exe (analysis/online_v7, PR #29; 20 calls x 50 sets, seed 7, best R = 102.8059). Calls 1-11 are the v4 seed-7 batches unchanged; from call 12 v7 keeps v4's full batch and replaces only zero-yield fine/zero/combo slots with coarse/block/restart moves. The surrogate's GP kernel hyperparameters are not here: they are fitted from scratch on every call (decision 33).
_sources.seed: Seed 7, unchanged from the v4 package, so the v7 evidence and the v4 comparison share the same random stream.
_sources.calls_batch: Course rule: at most 20 sequential calls of at most 50 sets (decision 19).
_sources.solver_timeout_seconds: A 50-set call took 289-643 s on the team's Windows PCs; the timeout leaves a wide margin.
_sources.blas: Linear-algebra rounding depends on the OpenBLAS kernel and thread count. The v7 reference log was recorded on 12 logical CPUs; Haswell on 12 threads reproduces those batches and runs on every x86-64 CPU with AVX2. run.py forces these values before import numpy and fails loudly if the real BLAS does not match.
